Field: Law / 12/GIUR-06 Diritto amministrativo e pubblico

item.title: Incarico post-doc: The Evolution of Competition Law and Antitrust Enforcement: Substantive Legal Issues and Judicial Review. Collaboration in teaching activities within the Competition Law course. (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-17 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-06 Diritto amministrativo e pubblico

The position requires a PhD in Public and Administrative Law or a related or equivalent field, a solid methodological background, and in-depth knowledge of substantive and procedural law, particularly competition law and antitrust enforcement. Candidates will be assessed on the quality and relevance of their scientific publications, including those in English, participation in international conferences and national or international research projects, and study or research experience abroad. Documented experience in supporting teaching activities conducted in English will be considered a preferential qualification.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: The Governance of Emerging Environmental and Health Emergencies in the Digital Age (Univ. CATANIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-07 12:00
Institution: Univ. CATANIA, Catania
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-05 Diritto costituzionale e pubblico

The project aims to analyse new environmental and health emergencies arising from the interaction between climate change, ecosystem alteration, and the spread of emerging pathogens, with particular attention to the One Health paradigm. The research will examine crisis management within the Italian legal system, as well as European and international strategies concerning sustainability and health security, together with the impact of new technologies. Particular attention will be devoted to the role of artificial intelligence in prevention, monitoring, and public decision-making processes. The results of the research will be disseminated through scientific publications.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Research on religious freedom in prison (special regimes, pluralism, female detention) and integrative teaching of Canon and Ecclesiastical Law. (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-07 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Rome
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-07 Diritto e religione

The ideal candidate must have proven research experience in the field of religious freedom law, with particular reference to its protection within the prison system and its balancing with order and security requirements. Professional and scientific research experience regarding the protection of religious freedom in detention is required, with a specific focus on special prison regimes and female detention. Qualifying elements include the aforementioned professional experience and participation in research projects on religious freedom in prison, pluralism, and vulnerability.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Commercial Law in the Papal States of the Restoration: The Provisional Regulation of 1821 Between the Napoleonic Legacy and the ius commune (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-02 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-16 Storia del diritto medievale e moderno

This research will analyze papal commercial law during the Restoration era, examining the impact of Napoleonic legislation on common law beginning with the 1821 Regulation. The study will examine the debate on commercial jurisdiction, codification projects, and university teaching in Rome. Based on archival sources and contemporary legal scholarship, the study aims to chart the comparison between the “mos italicus” and the French school. The ultimate goal is a comprehensive reconstruction of the system, complete with a bibliography of sources and scholarly publications
